name: Gods Omniscience
overview: God's omniscience is revealed in Scripture as His perfect and infinite knowledge, encompassing all creation and events from beginning to end. The Lord understands the intricate workings of the natural world, as seen in Job's reference to the 'wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge' and the Psalms' affirmation of His boundless understanding. He observes every detail, both good and evil, and declares the end from the beginning, ensuring His counsel and purposes are unchangeable. Even the smallest occurrences, such as a sparrow falling, are fully known and governed by the Father, demonstrating His comprehensive and intimate awareness.
